hypotheses.F0_native_path_is_exact: Native finite paths match independent logits within maximum absolute error 0.02.
hypotheses.F1_context_rank4_is_causally_strong: Semantic modes plus context/CE rank four have mean finite full-logit fidelity at least 0.80.
hypotheses.F2_route_geometry_predicts_finite_causal: Across twenty layer/allocation cells, replication route fidelity and finite full-logit fidelity correlate at least 0.70.
hypotheses.F3_L15_is_a_static_weight_regime: At L15, pure weight rank four is within 0.05 finite fidelity of context rank four.
hypotheses.F4_L11_needs_only_one_context_coordinate: At L11, three weight plus one context coordinate are within 0.05 finite fidelity of context rank four.
hypotheses.F5_early_layers_need_context_conditionin: At L1 and L4, pure weights trail context rank four by at least 0.10 finite fidelity.
hypotheses.F6_two_context_coordinates_improve_the_w: At least three of four layers improve over pure weights when two context coordinates replace two weight coordinates.
